Dear Honeywell Engineering Team,

Honeywell Technologies' position as a global pure-play automation leader—driving the industrial sector's pivotal transition from automation to autonomy through the Honeywell Technologies Accelerator operating system and Honeywell Technologies Forge intelligence layer—represents the exact standard of mission-critical engineering I aspire to contribute to. As a Computer Science and Engineering undergraduate at Bannari Amman Institute of Technology (CGPA: 8.28/10), I am eager to bring fresh perspectives, strong analytical skills, and a dedication to continuous improvement to your engineering team in Bengaluru as an Intern.

My technical foundation directly aligns with Honeywell's core intern responsibilities in project execution, data analysis, and technical research. In architecting \textbf{PatentIQ}, I engineered an \textbf{autonomous AI agent} workflow leveraging the \textbf{Model Context Protocol (MCP)} and \textbf{tool calling}, dynamically orchestrating vector retrieval tools, patent claim parsers, and external research APIs. Furthermore, I built a low-latency \textbf{RAG} pipeline utilizing local \textbf{LLMs (Qwen2.5 via Ollama)} and Pinecone vector embeddings to automate unstructured data analysis, technical feasibility research, and quantitative risk scoring. In \textbf{DB Backup CLI (DBVault)}---published to npm and Docker Hub with \textbf{120 automated tests}---I engineered multi-database disaster recovery with authenticated AES-256-GCM encryption, Redis/BullMQ distributed job scheduling, and AWS S3 offloading to guarantee zero data loss. Furthermore, my hands-on deployment of Prometheus and Grafana telemetry in a Kubernetes cluster (\texttt{node-monitoring-k8s}) reflects practical readiness for real-time industrial monitoring and observability.

Honeywell's culture of precision and continuous improvement strongly mirrors my software craftsmanship. In my merged contribution to \textbf{ESLint Core (PR \#21218)}, I resolved intricate IEEE 754 floating-point underflow edge cases in AST static analysis, authoring comprehensive regression test suites that passed \textbf{43 automated CI verification checks}. Backing this rigor, I have solved \textbf{1200+ algorithmic problems} across LeetCode, CodeChef, and GeeksforGeeks, and hold verified credentials including \textbf{Oracle Cloud Certified Foundations Associate}, \textbf{AWS Cloud Practitioner Essentials}, and IIT Madras / NPTEL's \textit{Joy of Computing using Python} (Elite + Topper, 95\% score). As a Web Developer with Students Special Group, I collaborated with cross-functional teams to engineer project tracking portals and faculty reporting dashboards, actively contributing in technical design reviews and mentoring \textbf{50+ students}.

I would welcome the opportunity to support your team's day-to-day project deliverables, assist with data analysis and reporting, and contribute innovative ideas toward Honeywell's autonomous automation solutions. Thank you for your time, consideration, and review of my application.
